description:
Verso (original use): Letter from Maḍmūn b. Ḥāsan, in Aden, to Avraham Ibn Yijū, in India. Mentioning Bama and Abū l-Khayr (probably Ibn Yijū's maternal cousin of this name, mentioned in several of his documents). Dated: 529 AH (תקטכ) = 1134/35 CE. Needs further examination.

Probably a join with Moss. IV,21.1 + T-S NS J240 + T-S 20.137 (PGPID 5448).
description_he: מכתב ביהודית-ערבית מהמאה ה-12 מעדן. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
